description.value: Chai Wagon is a Vancouver café dedicated to authentic Indian chai, brewed fresh daily and served alongside traditional comfort food and sweet treats. Located in the Mount Pleasant neighbourhood on East 2nd Avenue, it also offers catering, corporate orders, and a franchise program, suggesting a well-established operation. A touring cyclist looking for a warming, flavourful break in Vancouver's inner east side will find a distinct alternative to the typical coffee stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, active café at 196 East 2nd Avenue serving authentic Indian chai and comfort food, with online ordering and catering services listed. The contact page reveals a different location phone number — (778) 7378033 — compared to OSM's +1-778-680-6794, flagged as a discrepancy. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null; however, the 'Order Here' link confirms takeout is available.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-778-680-6794, but the website contact page lists (778) 7378033 for the location and 778.665.0028 for the head office. The website value (778-737-8033) has been used for the top-level phone field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café with a functioning website, confirmed address, and online ordering. A useful stop for touring cyclists passing through Vancouver's Mount Pleasant area.
